purpose: Define the historical regional climate baseline used as a prior for Japan 90-day golf date ranking. One representative point per subregion; all courses in that subregion inherit the same regional assessment.

geography.pointPolicy: Use the existing accepted regional representative point. Exact course pin/fairway precision is not required. Do not create per-course weather records within a subregion.
geography.gridMappingStatus: expected nearest-neighbour mapping; pilot download must verify actual returned coordinates

baseline.leapDayPolicy: Map February 29 to the February 28/March 1 pooled window; retain original source date in raw records.
baseline.missingDataPolicy: Keep null/missing values; never convert missing precipitation to zero. Suppress climatology metrics below completeness thresholds.
baseline.dailyAggregationRule: Download at least one UTC day before and after the requested local date range. Convert each hourly UTC valid_time to Asia/Tokyo, then group into JST calendar days 00:00-23:00. Require exactly 24 valid hourly samples per complete local day.
baseline.precipitationHandling: For the ERA5-Land hourly time-series endpoint, total_precipitation is documented as de-accumulated hourly values in metres. Convert each hourly value to millimetres (x1000), then sum the 24 JST-hour values. Do not de-accumulate a second time. For the full ERA5-Land hourly fallback, use its own accumulation/de-accumulation handling and never reuse this rule blindly.

sourceStrategy.temporalResolution: hourly UTC; convert valid_time to Asia/Tokyo before daily aggregation
sourceStrategy.spatialMethod: Submit the representative course locality to the CDS location selector; CDS rounds it to the nearest 0.1-degree grid point. Compare returned NetCDF latitude/longitude against config/global/era5-land-grid-points-japan.json.
sourceStrategy.limitations: The ERA5-Land hourly time-series endpoint is optimized for single-point long time series but ECMWF describes it as experimental/not recommended for production; response file structure may change. Use it for pilot/schema validation only. Production fallback is the full ERA5-Land hourly dataset with explicit spatial extraction and de-accumulation.

variableHandling.total_precipitation: The time-series product provides de-accumulated hourly precipitation in metres. Convert to mm (x1000) and sum by JST day. Verify returned metadata and reconstruct sample totals where possible.
variableHandling.temperatures: Source unit Kelvin; convert to Celsius by subtracting 273.15.
variableHandling.windComponents: Source unit m s**-1; preserve U/V and derive speed/direction.

sourceStrategy.spatialMethod: Select suitable nearby long-running stations by region and elevation/coastal context; retain station distance and elevation difference. Do not substitute station data for the regional grid without documenting representativeness.
sourceStrategy.limitations: Station observations are point measurements and may not represent elevated, coastal, or mountainous golf areas.

sourceStrategy.spatialMethod: Use nearby JMA stations as independent monthly context; choose stations by geography, elevation and coastal/mountain exposure and record distance/elevation difference.
sourceStrategy.limitations: Monthly station normals are not daily time-series data and cannot alone produce date-specific wet-day frequency or daily rainfall percentiles.

precipitation.dailyTotal: sum hourly total_precipitation after unit conversion to mm
precipitation.wetDayFrequency: fraction of valid calendar-window days with daily precipitation >= 1 mm
precipitation.medianDailyRainMm: median daily total precipitation including dry days
precipitation.percentile90DailyRainMm: 90th percentile daily total precipitation including dry days

humidity.dailyMeanRelativeHumidity: derive hourly relative humidity from 2m_temperature and 2m_dewpoint_temperature, then daily mean; document formula and clamp to 0-100%

wind.direction: derive meteorological wind direction from u10/v10; preserve vector components in raw data

qualityGates: All 16 mainland subregions resolve to exactly one regional representative point from the canonical registry.
No subregion is expanded into separate per-course climate points.
All source records retain provider, dataset, retrieval time, valid date, source version and spatial extraction metadata.
No missing precipitation is interpreted as a dry day.
ERA5 reanalysis and JMA station observations remain separately identified.
Each subregion has at least 24 valid baseline years and >=90% daily completeness before its climatology is marked usable.
Historical climatology is a seasonal prior for 19-90 day ranking, not a deterministic daily forecast.

enableOnlyAfter: historical source data have been downloaded and archived
all 16 subregions pass spatial and temporal coverage checks
daily aggregation and unit conversions are tested
JMA cross-check coverage and limitations are documented
regional baseline summaries are independently inspected
ERA5-Land grid resolution, nearest-cell coordinates and elevation/coastal representativeness are recorded for every subregion.

climatologyEngine.seasonYearAssignment: For windows crossing December/January, December observations are assigned to the following January target season year; January observations are assigned to the preceding December target season year.
climatologyEngine.leapDayHandling: February 29 maps to calendar ordinal 59.5, midway between February 28 and March 1. It is included in both adjacent rolling windows when within 15 calendar days. Leap-year windows that include February 29 have 32 expected daily records and require at least 29 valid days at 90% completeness.
climatologyEngine.annualCompleteness: Each metric is qualified independently. A season year is valid when at least 90% of the expected calendar-window daily values for that metric are present. At least 24 valid season years are required.

tripDateRankingEngine.tripWindowPolicy: The 90-day calendar horizon yields 86 complete rolling five-day trip windows. Day 1 is arrival/transfer, days 2-4 are the fixed three consecutive golf days, and day 5 is departure/transfer. Do not select the three lowest-risk dates from all five days.
tripStartRankingOrder: average wetDayFrequencyPct across fixed golf days 2-4 ascending
average heavyRain10mmFrequencyPct across fixed golf days 2-4 ascending
average heavyRain30mmFrequencyPct across fixed golf days 2-4 ascending
average p90DailyRainMm across fixed golf days 2-4 ascending
tripDateRankingEngine.minimumCoverage: All five trip dates require usable historical precipitation statistics; ranking metrics are calculated only from the fixed middle three golf dates. Missing metrics block the candidate; no zero-fill.
tripDateRankingEngine.interpretation: Historical 1991-2020 seasonal climatology prior only; not a deterministic daily weather forecast or a guarantee.
tripDateRankingEngine.shortRangeForecastPolicy: Do not alter the existing 1-16 day live forecast path in this stage. A later fusion stage must retain distinct forecast maturity labels and must not present climatology as daily forecast.
tripDateRankingEngine.leapDayPolicy: For an actual February 29 departure/trip date, use the arithmetic midpoint of February 28 and March 1 historical rainfall statistics; both adjacent calendar-day climatology metrics must be usable.

leadDayPolicy.source: weekly trend only; no daily score
historical same-day baseline plus seasonal trend estimate
seasonal outlook and historical climate reference

forecastMaturityEngine.confidencePolicy: Keep data confidence/source coverage separate from rainfall and playability risk. Long-range wet-day frequency estimates must never be labelled as daily rain probability.
forecastMaturityEngine.formalV1Scoring: Do not change existing date-engine V1 weights or suitability thresholds in this stage.

climatologyEvidenceExporter.february29Policy: Interpolate means and wet-day frequency from February 28 and March 1; withhold P90 and heavy-rain frequencies because percentiles cannot be reconstructed by averaging.
climatologyEvidenceExporter.minimumValidYears: Use climatology output minimumValidYears; metrics below threshold remain null.

acquisition.caveat: Grid coordinates are expected nearest-neighbour points only; each downloaded file must pass returned-coordinate, variable, units and hourly-coverage inspection.
